transport_contract.HTTP: Preserve immutable request bytes and method/request identity; collect response Uint8Array plus actual integer HTTP status and completion facts before parsing. Proposed local response cap16MiB matches existing app-protocol MAX_RESPONSE (line10), not frozen schema maximum; its separate MAX_REQUEST is8MiB. Content-Length early check plus counted streaming bytes, timeout/abort/error/incomplete end refusal, no redirects. UTF8 fatal and one complete JSON value after HTTP body end; no prefix acceptance. Main v2 original request should retain existing API1MiB envelope resource cap rather than inheriting proxy8MiB.
transport_contract.legacy: Keep callCore legacy11 output adapter identical; v2 opts into new transport. Do not silently change shared request success shape for v1 routes/artifact reader.
transport_contract.HTTP_errors: Non2xx first classified by HTTP status; only then optionally decode bounded published short {error:ProtocolError}. Internal/api/v2.go240-246 deliberately lacks CommandResponse identity before DecodeEnvelope. A short error is never a complete-command authority; arbitrary nonJSON400/401/403/500 remains transport failure and no adopt. Do not fix API router.
transport_contract.wire_retention: Byte buffers/status remain main or browser fetch boundary until validation; receipt-only fixture evidence records exact raw/Base64/SHA/length. Renderer gets validated public data/error enum, never Authorization/session token, arbitrary body snippets, credential/private path or main raw wire cache.
transport_contract.native: MAX_FRAME8192 preserved. fatalUTF8+full NativeKind/payload schema and bootstrap client/host/protocol/credential_exposed=false before readSession. Node data is not a proven Windows named-pipe message boundary; first parseable JSON cannot finish. Existing Go writes payload then FlushFileBuffers before disconnect. Need independent real frame-completion solution/control before this branch can close; do not assume waiting EOF cannot deadlock or append newline to frozen protocol.

exact_numbers.rules: Raw JSON tokenizer preserves numeric lexemes and decoded strings before any Number conversion; recursively reject duplicate decoded keys, lone surrogate/invalid UTF8, trailing values, and bounded depth/token exhaustion. Mathematical integer/range/const/enum checked from exact decimal rational, never float64 then recover. Null must remain null; missing does not become null/0.
exact_numbers.proposal: Represent integer authorities as native Number only when safe and exact, otherwise BigInt internally; lossless serializer emits JSON numeric literals, never quoted revision strings. IPC structured-clone and React/web/legacy comparisons/rendering must use shared exact comparison/display helpers. Original public wire schema unchanged. At least9007199254740991→9007199254740992 preserved, adjacent9007199254740993 never collides; no Number.isSafeInteger-only contract narrowing. Fractional result numbers retain raw exact semantics for schema then explicit safe display, no fractional authority accepted.
exact_numbers.scope_consequence: v2 envelopes, HTTP/browser request serialization, event watermarks, latest-revision comparison, JSON-details and draft read metadata in these renderer paths must be updated consistently. context.js persists only project/session IDs and remains protected. Additional callers found to coerce authoritative integers require a precise amendment, not hidden truncation.

identity_and_adoption: Validate protocol_version, command_id including null, original exact method; full method/status schema before any response callback or state mutation. strict identity cannot be optional.

Bind client to original request/native authenticated context; top response has no client/project fields. HostStatusResult.client_id equals caller where present; session/project result snapshots match original requested scope. Do not require foreign writer.client_id to equal caller for legitimate readonly snapshot; only own/unexpired actual writer permits subsequent writes.

Method-specific derived session.create COMPLETED must have one matching nonnull top/result SID and request project; goal.start nullable topSession does not grant create exception. Lists and host-level responses cannot rebase Session from an unrelated result or host revision.

Build candidate complete tuple project/session/revision/writerEpoch/cursor against captured request generation; commit it once after all validations. Concurrent old response after project/session switch cannot partially overwrite. Rejected/ACK/malformed/transport loss do not mutate authority or drafts.

A valid snapshot may disclose a foreign writer and still be adopted as readonly; store disclosure separately from writable authority. Epoch+revision integers and expires_at must validate, own expired/null writer remains no-write. Do not make snapshot presence imply attach command COMPLETED.

Legal ACK retains original command/PendingResult and disables dependent mutation; explicit readonly snapshot/events refresh may show newer facts but cannot synthesize original command completion. No new command retry/second scheduler or automatic re-claim. COMPLETED session.send is durable admission, not execution/acceptance; CANCEL/RESUME terminal semantics remain domain-gated.
